verdict.rationale: Galileo is an AI observability and evaluation SaaS with SDKs and APIs, so API versioning and deprecation policy are fair questions to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions versioned API endpoints, API version identifiers, or a deprecation policy. Release notes exist but describe features only, and the OpenAPI spec probes returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
